test_correction.meaning: Writing the actual PTY invitation sets the Darwin kernel-only FWASWRITTEN bit. The write-only control reproduces2->65538 without Tokio/kqueue and proves F_SETFL cannot clear that marker. Compare all public OFlag values including O_NONBLOCK, with exact termios restoration and real output unchanged.

implementation_change: Move the unchanged terminal preparation syscalls and invitation into a private shared operation. Production uses the same invitation, stdin modes, signal handling, bounded editor and restoration. No public callback API or settings change.
native_interface_adaptation: Source uses a mock PassThrough isRaw property and writer; native exercises actual owned PTY/file attributes inside the invitation callback of the ordinary private preparation operation. Its real master output must be exactly the invitation and contain no synthetic secret.
independent_review: Distribution reviewer checked ordering, actual PTY output and invitation-panic Input/AsyncFd Drop restoration.
scope_limits: Focused current-host synthetic PTYs and frozen source callback only; shipping/archive and broader platform qualification remain separate.
Retained earlier broad-filter failures include sandbox loopback denials and the raw kernel-marker comparison; subsequent exact six tests and strict CLI Clippy pass.
